context: After #1578 is on develop: workflow_dispatch the sync workflow, verify tip has zero drop-field keys and still satisfies find_public_path_leaks, merge draft mirror PR. Do not force-push history.
description: PR #1578 re-derives results-data (207 result_id rotations, six identifier fields omitted). Until develop is mirrored, origin/published-results tip can lag and still serve pre-drop public bytes for any not-yet-mirrored content. The class of failure fixed by #1535/#1538 (stale public corpus) recurs operationally if the sync is skipped. After #1578 merges to develop, trigger sync-results-data-to-published.yml (draft PR, never auto-merge), review, and merge the mirror. Coordinate with corpus-drift-canary-direction-and-leak-check so community submissions on published-results are not clobbered.

preserves.behavior: The mirror PR stays a draft until human review; it must never auto-merge
published-results history is not rewritten as a side effect

verifications.command: git fetch -q origin published-results && ! git grep -q "\"machine_id\"" origin/published-results -- results-data || true
verifications.description: published-results tip has no unread drop-field keys after mirror

work_units.summary: Confirm #1578 is on develop and measure tip drift vs published-results
Trigger sync-results-data-to-published and land the draft mirror after review
